constituents.headquarters_location: Melville, New York Davidson, North Carolina

purpose: Freeze a genuinely unseen, sector-balanced S&P MidCap 400 control universe before any strategy performance or backtest result is inspected.

selection.method: For each lexicographically sorted GICS sector, rank eligible ticker symbols by SHA-256(seed|sector|ticker), then take four. If a sector has fewer than four, fill the remaining target slots by SHA-256(seed|FALLBACK|ticker).

source.retrieval_method: HTTP GET plus first table.wikitable.sortable component-table parse
